{"id": "931b0efb-943b-4c36-bb35-2b8b8841bdd7", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "The request body uses the Anthropic Claude text-completion format, but Nova models need the Messages format.

I couldn't call `GetFunction` because the agent's role doesn't have `lambda:GetFunction`. The CloudWatch traceback shows the offending line, though (`/var/task/app.py`, line 6):

```python
boto3.client("bedrock-runtime").invoke_model(
    modelId="us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0",
    body=json.dumps({
        "prompt": "\n\nHuman: Summarise order 1042\n\nAssistant:",
        "max_tokens_to_sample": 50
    })
)
```

Bedrock's error says `required key [messages] not found`. `prompt` and `max_tokens_to_sample` are the legacy Claude v2 text-completion fields. Nova doesn't accept them, and it rejects any body without `messages`.

**Fix with InvokeModel.** Use the Nova request schema:

```python
body = json.dumps({
    "schemaVersion": "messages-v1",
    "messages": [
        {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Summarise order 1042"}]}
    ],
    "inferenceConfig": {"max_new_tokens": 50}
})
resp = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime").invoke_model(
    modelId="us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0", body=body
)
out = json.loads(resp["body"].read())
text = out["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"]
```

- The prompt goes in `messages[].content[].text`. Drop the `\n\nHuman:` and `\n\nAssistant:` markers.
- The token limit is `inferenceConfig.max_new_tokens`, not `max_tokens_to_sample`.
- The response is also different. Read `output.message.content[0].text` instead of a `completion` field.

**Alternative: the Converse API.** It uses one request shape across models, so you won't hit this again if you switch models:

```python
resp = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime").converse(
    modelId="us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Summarise order 1042"}]}],
    inferenceConfig={"maxTokens": 50},
)
text = resp["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"]
```

If you switch to `converse`, the Lambda role needs `bedrock:InvokeModel`, which also covers `Converse`. The role also needs access to the inference profile and the underlying foundation models in the regions it routes to.

This error has been recurring since at least 2026-11-05 in the log group. It comes from the code and not from an outage, so the fix above should clear it.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
